name: Stuff You Should Know
description: If you've ever wanted to know about champagne, satanism, the Stonewall Uprising, chaos theory, LSD, El Nino, true crime and Rosa Parks, then look no further. Josh and Chuck have you covered.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Boston Molasses Flood
episodes.description: In 1919 one of the most bizarre disasters in history took place in Boston’s North End when a really fast, towering wave of molasses covered the neighborhood, killing people and animals in horrific ways and knocking buildings from their foundations. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Zorro! That guy with the sword!
episodes.description: All Chuck knew of Zorro was from a couple of movies. So today the guys dive deeper on the legendary figure cutting so many Zs into so many things. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: The Taliesin Massacre
episodes.description: Everyone knows who Frank Lloyd Wright is, but did you know there was a grisly massacre at his home in 1914? Find out all about it in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Wilmington Massacre
episodes.description: In the late 1800s, white supremacists in Wilmington, NC staged a coup and bloody massacre of its black citizens in order to stem the tide of black progress and stifle the vote. This is that story. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Weather Balloons
episodes.description: Weather balloons are the workhorse of the meteorological world, which is why they’ve been used daily around the world for most of a century. Let’s salute these unsung heroes of weather prediction by getting to know them better.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Ba-Dum-Bum Goes Your Heart!
episodes.description: Have you ever wondered what makes your ticker tick? Josh and Chuck take you back to high school biology for a stroll through the ins and outs of the little pump that keeps everything from your lowly pinky toe to your mighty brain going strong. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Salem Witchcraft Trials: More Bonkers Than You Know
episodes.description: Looking back 300 years on, it’s easy to overgeneralize why the Salem Villagers decided to persecute (and execute) their neighbors. But as much as this story has become an American history chestnut, we still don’t understand why Salem lost its mind. Listen to this classic episode to find out what we think we know and what we don't. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The SYSK Annual Halloween Freaky Spooktacular 2026!
episodes.description: Get yourself ready to freak out with this year’s extra-freak Halloween freak-fest, starring the voice acting talents of Chuck and Josh. This year we feature stories from WW Jacobs and WF Harvey, both of whom, if they were alive, would love this episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: The Enfield Monster
episodes.description: Did a strange cryptid show up in Enfield, Illinois in 1973? Some people think so. DO YOU? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: (Don't Fear) The (Grim) Reaper
episodes.description: Cultures have come up with lots of personifications of death: Young and attractive? Yes. Riding a black buffalo? Check. Covered in tongues and eyeballs? Uh-huh. But in the West there’s only been one go-to soul taker for hundreds of years: The Grim Reaper. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: John Lennon and the FBI
episodes.description: Did you know that Richard Nixon had a FBI case file open on Beatle John Lennon? Well he did! Why? Listen to this classic episode to find out. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Twilight Zone Episode
episodes.description: Today, Chuck and Josh unlock a door with the key of imagination. Beyond it is another dimension. A dimension of sound, a dimension of sight, a dimension of mind. You're moving into a land of both shadow and substance, of things and ideas. You've just crossed over into... the Twilight Zone. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Spooky Recommendations
episodes.description: This week Josh and Chuck are trying something a little different, some recomemdations for the spooky season. For Josh, it's some movies, for Chuck, it's some books. Check it out and let us know what you think! See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Winnie the Pooh: Silly Old Bear
episodes.description: On Dec 24, 1925, the world got a Christmas gift from a little-known writer named A.A. Milne when the first Winnie the Pooh story was published. Milne was inspired by the imaginative woodland strolls he shared with his son, the real-life Christopher Robin. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Sacagawea: Impressive Teen
episodes.description: Sacagawea was only 16 when she joined the Corps of Discovery. That is one seriously impressive teenager. Find out all about her in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Disappearance of Dorothy Arnold
episodes.description: When socialite Dorothy Arnold disappeared in 1910, no one imagined the case would remain forever unsolved. Today we tell her story. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Currency Symbols
episodes.description: In today's shorty, Josh and Chuck go over the stories behind some of the world's currency symbols. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Asteroooooid De-FENSE!
episodes.description: There’s no question that millions of asteroids are circling the Earth at incredible speed and every one of them is just dying to get a chance to smoosh our planet and wipe out life in the universe once and for all. But Earth has an ace up its sleeve: Us! See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: What's the deal with swing states?
episodes.description: Swing states are all the rage once again this election season, but the makeup has changed a bit. In this classic episode, learn all about what makes a swing state a swing state right now. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Stand-Up Pt II
episodes.description: The SYSK boys continue the episode on stand-up comedy in part two, placing it in the rarefied company of other two-parters like Evel Knievel, the Hoover Dam, and the Trail of Tears. In this ep: should anything be off limits for stand-up? Consensus: no. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: The Style Cycle
episodes.description: Why do clothing styles get stale and then come back into fashion? Listen in to find out. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Stand-Up Comedy Pt I
episodes.description: Chuck and Josh do their best to tackle “the craft,” which most normal people call stand-up comedy. Stand-up dates back to the vaudeville days but it really started to take off in the 60s when comics stopped wearing suits and started getting edgy. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: How Bras Work
episodes.description: Bras are loved and hated, sometimes at the same time. But as difficult and restrictive as they can be, they rescued women from a much cruel contraption: corsets. The question remains, though, do women need bras at all? Listen to this classic episode to find out. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Let's Thank Universal Pictures for Monster Movies!
episodes.description: Basically everything you think of when you think of vampires, mummies, werewolves, and Frankenstein all come from a spate of films made in the 1930s, and every one of them by Universal Pictures. Amazingly, they are still among the best films ever made. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: The Retirement Curse
episodes.description: Is retirement bad for your health? Well it certainly can be if you don't take steps to prevent it. Listen in to learn more about the "retirement curse." See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: A Good Walk Ruined: The History of Golf
episodes.description: The history of golf is a bit muddled, but once it was truly born in Scotland, it started the beginning of lifelong obsessions for people dumb enough to pick up a club and give it a try. Learn all about the early history of the most frustrating game ever invented. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Wetlands! Wetlands! Wetlands!
episodes.description: It’s time to get jazzed up for some Earth science of the waterlogged variety. Join Chuck and Josh in this classic episode as they tour some of the most interesting ecosystems on the planet and learn why we need to stop destroying them post haste. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Introducing 3 Putt Bogey
episodes.description: 3 Putt Bogey is a golf podcast hosted by Chuck Bryant and Adam Pranica, two mid handicappers who are just good enough to know exactly how bad they still are. The name says it all: one great shot, followed immediately by the kind of self-inflicted disaster only a mid-handicap golfer can produce. That's the whole sport, really, and this show lives in that gap. Every week, Chuck and Adam break down their most recent rou

episodes.title: Emily Post: Ettiquette Queen
episodes.description: In today's episode, we detail the life and times of ettiquette queen Emily Post. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Mabon
episodes.description: Mabon is often called the Pagan Thanksgiving  but though it seems like it’s as ancient as Halloween, it’s actually only around 50 years old. But, pagan or not, it’s a great chance to really feel the fall and thank Mother Earth. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Our Big Fat Dream Episode
episodes.description: No you’re no dreaming – go ahead, pinch yourself – we’ve finally made an episode on dreams! We’ve done episodes on lucid dreaming, night terrors, sleepwalking, sleep paralysis – basically everything but dreams themselves. Well, at long last here it is! See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Fallout Shelters: Probably Useless (Let’s Never Find Out)
episodes.description: The advent of nuclear weapons and the Cold War kicked off a craze in the US for building rec rooms with foot-thick reinforced walls and outfitted with survival rations and board games. Would they work? Probably not. Find out (but not really) in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK Gets Weird Playlist: What is Collective Hysteria?
episodes.description: Throughout the history of the world, there have been many cases of what is known as collective hysteria - groups of people, usually young women, who all exhibit the same physical symptoms of non-existent conditions. Is it psychosomatic? Is it group think? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK Gets Weird Playlist: What was the Philadelphia Experiment?
episodes.description: The Philadelphia Experiment is a bad movie from the 1980s, and also the conspiracy theory that refuses to die, despite virtually zero evidence of its occurrence. Learn all about this strange non-event in today's show. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK Gets Weird Playlist: Mermaids: Not a real thing
episodes.description: Mermaids aren't real. That much we know. But the history and lore of these magical and sometimes menacing creatures of the sea is pretty interesting stuff. Learn all about these half women/half fish today. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK Gets Weird Playlist: Will We Find Evidence of Aliens by Their Engineering Projects?
episodes.description: In 1960 physicist Freeman Dyson suggested that in the hunt for alien life, we should search for evidence of massive engineering projects that encapsulate stars with solar arrays to harness their energy. Could we humans ever make one ourselves? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK Gets Weird Playlist: The Mystery of the Mary Celeste
episodes.description: When the Mary Celeste was discovered floating and abandoned in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean one day in 1872, the legend of the ghost ship was born. Why did the Mary Celeste’s crew disappear? Was it pirates? Mutiny? UFOs? Well, probably not that last one. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK Gets Weird Playlist: The Max Headroom Incident
episodes.description: In 1987, a very strange broadcast intrusion occurred in the city of Chicago. For just a couple of minutes, the odd TV character Max Headroom appeared onscreen in the middle of an episode of Dr. Who. He spoke in garbled tones, brandished a marital aid, and was spanked on the rear with a fly swatter by a person dressed in Annie Oakley garb. If this sounds weird, it is. It's the Max Headroom Incident. See omnystudio.com

episodes.title: SYSK Gets Weird Playlist: Dragons: As Real as Mermaids
episodes.description: Dragons are like mermaids in that they're not real. And that's about where the comparison ends. Learn all about dragons today. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK Gets Weird Playlist: The Creepy Legacy of the Hotel Cecil
episodes.description: The Hotel Cecil in downtown Los Angeles has had no less than 16 unnatural deaths, from suicides to murders and everything in between. Listen in to the history of this decidedly creepy hotel.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK Gets Weird Playlist: What's the deal with blue people?
episodes.description: The famous blue people of Kentucky are no longer blue. But why were they like that in the first place? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK Gets Weird Playlist: Doppelgängers: Hey you, you're me!
episodes.description: Seeing your near twin is probably pretty weird. But could there be a genetic commonality as well? You bet  there could!   See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK Gets Weird Playlist: The Story of the Nuclear Boy Scout
episodes.description: David Hahn was a kid who was really into science. So much that he built a nuclear reactor in his mother's potting shed. And it worked.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Cancer Episode
episodes.description: Cancer is a terrible word in any language for at least two reasons: It’s incredibly difficult to get rid of once it grows in the body, and there’s a very good chance that you or someone close to you will be diagnosed with it. But hope is growing. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Leisure Suits
episodes.description: You know the leisure suit, perhaps the tackiest suit to ever be invented. It was so huge in the 70s and spread as wide the lapels of the shirts worn with them. Then, as fast as they hit the scene they disappeared in shame. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: How Boredom Works
episodes.description: Are there benefits to boredom? Or is it all negative? Why do we get bored? What can we do to break free from boredom? The answers to those questions and more are coming your way today. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Wasps: Not as cute as bees
episodes.description: Wasps have a bad rap. Because their sting really hurts and they don't make honey like their cousins. But they are super cool and you shouldn't kill them. Listen to this classic episode and learn! See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Odyssey Episode
episodes.description: Why does the story of The Odyssey endure this many years after it was first spoken? Listen in to find out. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Flappers
episodes.description: In the 1920s, a certain set of women wanted to loosen up and have a good time. Today, we get into it with the flappers. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Nickelodeon:The Best of Slimes
episodes.description: Today we tell the story of the kids TV network that changed it all, Nickelodeon. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Blacksmiths? You got that right!
episodes.description: Blacksmiths? You got that right. Learn all about this age old occupation in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Social Identity Theory: Your Group Rules, Others Drool
episodes.description: In the 80s, a pair of psychologists theorized why being part of a group can change people’s thoughts and feelings, both about themselves and other people. It sounds dry, but SIT explains everything from how people justify genocide to football rivalries. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Hisashi Ouchi
episodes.description: Japanese nuclear worker Hisashi Ouchi is often called on the internet “the world’s most radioactive man.” That’s not exactly true, but it gets the point across about how severe the fatal dose of radiation he received was. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Terry Fox: Greatest Canadian Hero
episodes.description: It is to the great nation of Canada’s lasting credit that it has prized Terry Fox as one of the most beloved and admired citizens for nearly 50 years now. It’s difficult to get across how much he means to Canada. Lucky for us, his story speaks for itself. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Flagpole Sitting: A Real Fad
episodes.description: The 1920s were just absolutely nuts. People got into weird fads really intensely and one of the strangest of all was flagpole sitting. It’s just what it sounds like – sitting on top of a flagpole for as long as you can. One man sat above them all. Learn all about him and many of these wild fads in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Fall of the USSR, Pt II
episodes.description: The break-up of the USSR was a tough one for Russia, being the jilted republic. For the entire decade after, the country plunged into a type of controlled chaos, with a rampantly corrupt kleptocracy taking the place of the toppled socialist society. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK Tribute: Why does everyone love Dolly Parton?
episodes.description: Today we dive in to celebrate the international treasure that is Dolly Parton. Why is she nearly universally loved? Listen in to find out. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Cyclospora
episodes.description: The US has an unusual number of outbreaks of food-borne illness going on in the summer of 2026, and the star of the show is cyclospora. How does this parasite make people sick, where does it come from? You may not want to know. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Fall of the USSR, Pt I
episodes.description: It’s rare that the downfall of an empire can be chalked up to the decisions of just one person. It’s even rarer, when the empire falls over the course of a year. That’s pretty much what happened with the Soviet Union when Mikhail Gorbachev dissolved it. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: How Narcolepsy Works
episodes.description: Narcolepsy is one of those amazing rare disorders that everyone thinks they understand – people just fall asleep at random times, even in the middle of doing something. But there’s a lot more to it and – even better – we actually may be able to explain it. Josh and Chuck run it down in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Rope, yeah ROPE!
episodes.description: Rope is one of the unsung heroes of the world of inventions. Think about it. Then let us tell you about it. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Did a shipwreck double the size of the United States?
episodes.description: Did a shipwreck double the size of the United States? Sort of. Listen in to find out what the heck that means. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Isn't It Ironic, Dontcha Think?
episodes.description: Irony is one of those things that you know when you see it, but it’s almost impossible to define. Well, that’s not quite right – there are a ton of definitions for irony but none of them quite capture it fully. Want to know what irony is? So do we! See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: The Manhattan Grid
episodes.description: Ever wanted to know more about how the Manhattan grid was made? Well this is your chance. Find out all about it in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Who was Robert Maxwell?
episodes.description: Robert Maxwell was a lot of things, publisher, mogul, spy, politician, crook. But was he murdered when he fell from his yacht? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Nero and His Fiddle
episodes.description: Did Nero play his fiddle while Rome burned during the Great Fire of 64 CE? Absolutely not. Find out how we know when Chuck and Josh bust a two thousand year-old myth.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Bonnie and Clyde
episodes.description: You've probably seen the movie, but what else do you know about this legendary crime couple? Listen in to find out. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Iran-Contra Affair: Shady in the 80s, Part 2
episodes.description: As the operation expands it also begins to unravel. Word starts to leak out of the illegal stuff the Reagan administration was up to, Congress and the press investigate and people start to point fingers. Spoiler alert – they all got off scot free. Find out how it all wraps up in part 2 of this classic story. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Iran-Contra Affair: Shady in the 80s, Part 1
episodes.description: When Ronald Reagan was president, America got involved in some deeply shady stuff, not the least of which was the Iran-Contra scandal – a convoluted operation that managed to combine an illegal covert war in Nicaragua with secretly selling arms to Iran. Learn all about it with Josh and Chuck in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Reggae: Kingston’s Gift to the World
episodes.description: Although it was built atop some musical styles that came before, reggae is mostly its own thing. It evolved as local music in the Trenchtown neighborhood in Kingston, Jamaica but after Bob Marley and the Wailers came along, it became a global phenomenon. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Phone Books
episodes.description: Once upon a time there were these things called phone books. Inside you could find the phone number and address of just about everyone in your town. Can you imagine? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Beans and Rice Feeds the World
episodes.description: To call beans and rice a staple is to undersell the importance of beans and rice. Today we break down the ubiquity of this beloved food combo. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: How Peanut Butter Works
episodes.description: No food is more all-American than peanut butter – 80 percent of homes in the country have a jar of it in the pantry right now. And while the rest of the world might find peanut butter peculiar, maybe even gross, the rest of the world is wrong. Enjoy a smooth ride through one of our top condiments in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: How Russia Shapes What the World Thinks
episodes.description: Operation Doppelganger was a Russian propaganda project discovered in 2022, a minor part of the enormous, ongoing disinformation and chaos-sewing campaign Russia spreads across the world through social media. And some of your views may have come from it. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Shark Arm Murders
episodes.description: Get yer info on one of Australia’s great true crime cases he-re!   See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Beloved Judy Blume
episodes.description: Judy Blume is more than an author. She's a legend in teen literature for her frank and honest portrayals of adolescence. Today we pay tribute to her. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Plant Migration
episodes.description: Climate change is having sweeping effects on our climate and this is changing the world, not just for humans and other animals, but plants too. Will the Earth’s flora manage to find safe refuge in time? Josh and Chuck run down the odds in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: What's the deal with Swiss neutrality?
episodes.description: We all know Switzerland is neutral. But why? Listen in and you might learn something. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Sardines!
episodes.description: Josh implored Chuck to try sardines. Did he? Listen in to find out.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Tobacco Master Settlement: That Time We Got Em
episodes.description: By the 1990s, cigarette makers had been hooking and killing off their customers for about a century. And they’d gotten good at both as well as covering up their harms. In 1994 they were still denying cigarettes were addictive. Then, the 50 Attorneys General of the US rode into town to take them on. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: The Soul Train Episode
episodes.description: In this classic episode, Chuck and Josh dive into the funky, cool world of the classic TV show, Sooooooooul Train. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: White Boy Rick
episodes.description: Would you believe that Detroit’s crack epidemic in the mid-80s was overseen by one 16 year-old white kid who supplied all the coke? No? Well, that’s not quite true, so okay. The actual story is even more nutso than that. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: The Voice of God
episodes.description: Today we salute the great Don LaFontaine, aka The Voice of God in movie and TV trailers.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: You Are Not Alone With Postpartum Depression
episodes.description: Most new moms get the baby blues soon after giving birth. Postpartum depression is something much different - the symptoms are similar, but their intensity can have sweeping effects on mom, baby, and the whole family. Fortunately, it’s highly treatable but the catch is moms usually have to ask for help. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: The First Road Trip
episodes.description: Back when cars were a brand new thing, before people even knew they'd stick around, two men and a dog drove from San Francisco to New York. This classic episode has their story. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Eleanor Roosevelt: Best First Lady
episodes.description: Eleanor Roosevelt was something else. We can't get into it here, but just wait until you listen to this episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Great Britain
episodes.description: Now that it’s been 250 years since America split from England, we figure enough time has passed that we can finally learn the difference between the UK, Great Britain, and  the British Isles. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Kola: The World’s Deepest Hole
episodes.description: During the Cold War all eyes were on the Space Race between the US and USSR. But there was another, overlooked race too and it went in the opposite direction.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Chopsticks > Forks
episodes.description: In this classic episode, Chuck and Josh sit and converse on the simple, elegant chopstick. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Alaska Earthquake of 1964
episodes.description: When a 9.2 quake shoook Alaska in 1964 it was the 2nd largest earthquake ever recorded. This is that story. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Toronto Clown Riot
episodes.description: Those are three words you probably never thought you’d see together. And the true story is just as interesting as it sounds. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Hillsborough Disaster
episodes.description: When a crush of football fans killed 97 people in England in 1989, police and officials engaged in a massive cover-up to blame it on drunken fans. Today we tell that story. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: How Enron Fooled the World
episodes.description: Until 2007, the largest single corporate bankruptcy was Enron, a $67 billion energy trading company. Its decline was breathtaking, and while it’s a fascinating story of corporate malfeasance and greed, it’s also about the lives of ruined workers. Learn all about it in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Freetown Christiania
episodes.description: The sort of commune of Freetown Christiania in Denmark may not be what it used to be, but it's still true to many of its original values. Learn all about this unique neighborhood today. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Why does it feel good to be scared?
episodes.description: Fear is different than being scared, most notably because fear is generally a negative thing and being scared can cause an enjoyable thrill. We'll get into the difference in today's episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Some Interesting Curses
episodes.description: Even though curses aren’t real – and we go to great pains to make that clear – they are pretty interesting, especially ones you haven’t heard of before. So we dug deep and found some of the curses that don’t always hog the spotlight for this fun episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Birthmarks: Probably Not the Mark of the Devil
episodes.description: It’s a pretty safe assumption that people have been born with birthmarks since humanity began, and between then and now we’ve come up with some wacky, even dangerous, explanations for them – even a few that survive still today. Learn all about them in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Stuff You Should Know Doin’ Science Playlist: How Chaos Theory Changed the Universe
episodes.description: Since the age of Descartes, science has put all of its eggs in the basket of determinism, the idea that with accurate enough measurements any aspect of the universe could be predicted. But the universe, it turns out, is not so tidy. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Stuff You Should Know Doin’ Science Playlist: How Global Warming Works
episodes.description: It's a confusing part of climate change when it seems winter is as cold as ever, but as global temperatures creep ever so slightly higher, a cascade of catastrophic events will almost surely follow. The ball is in humanity's court. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Stuff You Should Know Doin’ Science Playlist: How X-Rays Work
episodes.description: Like many huge discoveries, X-rays were accidentally stumbled upon. That serendipity led to a medical breakthrough still in use today. Learn about how X-rays are created and why they make such delightful images of our bones. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Stuff You Should Know Doin’ Science Playlist: Elastics: Where God and Science Smooch
episodes.description: You could be forgiven for thinking the story behind elastics was boring. You’d still be wrong, though. The story of what’s holding up your underwear is a global drama, replete with war, industrial espionage, colonialism, destitute inventors – everything! See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Stuff You Should Know Doin’ Science Playlist: Can Nuclear Fusion Reactors Save The World?
episodes.description: The world's energy consumption is ruining the planet but for decades physicists have been working on what could solve the world's energy and climate change woes for centuries to come - nuclear fusion. Learn about building stars on Earth in this episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Stuff You Should Know Doin’ Science Playlist: How Occam's Razor Works
episodes.description: You know the rule that says the simplest explanation is probably the correct one? That’s called a razor and it’s meant to guide logic. But over time it’s become a broadsword used to disprove opposing arguments. Learn how to spot a faux skeptic in this episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Stuff You Should Know Doin’ Science Playlist: Things We Believed Before the Scientific Method
episodes.description: It’s easy to think of people in the distant past as kinda dumb for believing things like that mice could spontaneously generate from old grain. But if you look a little deeper, you’ll find there was a sensibility to the odd beliefs that came before science. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Stuff You Should Know Doin’ Science Playlist: How Big Bang Theory Works, with Neil deGrasse Tyson
episodes.description: There are a number of theories for how the universe evolved but none are more widely accepted than the Big Bang theory. Learn about the mind-boggling details of the early universe and hear Dr. Neil deGrasse Tyson talk about what it will take for us to know its origins. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Stuff You Should Know Doin’ Science Playlist: How the Scientific Method Works
episodes.description: It evolved over centuries to become the gold standard for conducting scientific inquiry. Yet many people - including some scientists - don't fully understand it. Learn about the basis of how we explore our world in this episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Stuff You Should Know Doin’ Science Playlist: Legs! Legs! Legs! (The Periodic Table)
episodes.description: If you’ve ever wanted to listen to two totally untrained, non-chemists who are fully unqualified to explain how the periodic table works nervously explain how the periodic table works, then this episode is for you. Chemistry majors, be warned. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: M*A*S*H: The Story of the 4077th
episodes.description: Chuck loved M*A*S*H. Josh didn't. Listen in as they fight to the death. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Does singing make you happy?
episodes.description: Does singing make you happy? Yes, yes it does. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Did 24-Hour Cable News Kill America?
episodes.description: You can make a pretty good case that the rise of opinion “news” and filter bubbles on cable tv created the current cultural and political schism that plagues American society. How did it start? Where did it come from? And what the heck can we do about it? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: How the Fairness Doctrine Worked
episodes.description: Back in the day, broadcasters were bound by law to provide contrasting opinions on political matters. Why? Because of the Fairness Doctrine. What happened to it? Listen to this classic episode and find out. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The NY Subway Vigilante
episodes.description: Today we dive into the unremorseful life of NYC Subway vigilante Bernhard Goetz. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Rain Barrels!
episodes.description: Harvesting rainwater has tons of upsides and not many downsides – you just need to take a few precautions first. Don’t miss this episode, which features some Josh Math™. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Smile
episodes.description: They say that smiling requires fewer muscles than frowning, so why not smile? That doesn’t seem to be true, or at least unproven, and there is lots more about smiling that will keep you glued to your earbuds in this fun episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: 911 Is Not a Joke
episodes.description: Josh and Chuck delve into the world of 911 in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Three Mile Island
episodes.description: The disaster at Three Mile Island thankfully did not cost any lives directly, but the notion that it didn't harm people is very much up in the air. Learn all about the worst nuclear disaster in the history of the United States today. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: 1955 Le Mans Disaster
episodes.description: In 1955, the 24 Hours of Le Mans endurance motor race took a very dark turn when a terrible accident on the track continued into the crowd. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Tragic Life of Vincent Van Gogh
episodes.description: Van Gogh lived a troubled life and did not garner attention as a painter until after his death by suicide. Today we dive into this complicated journey as an artist. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Did Shakespeare really write all that stuff?
episodes.description: The question of Shakespeare's authorship has been around since at least the mid-1800s. Is there anything to it? In this classic episode, we dig in to this dense topic to find out. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Howard Hughes in Las Vegas
episodes.description: From 1968 to 1972 Howard Hughes holed up in a suite in the Desert Inn casino in Las Vegas. Addicted to morphine and living on candy bars and milk, he was in bad shape. When he was told to leave, he bought the hotel and stayed. Soon he owned half of Vegas. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Knuckle Cracking
episodes.description: Does knuckle cracking give you arthritis? It doesn't appear to. But that doesn't mean it's harmless. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Story of Starvation Heights
episodes.description: There are quacks and then there is Linda Hazzard. Not only did she starve her patients to death, but she took their family fortunes as she did it. This is the story of Starvation Heights. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: How Flight Attendants Work
episodes.description: Flight attendants have come a long way. From having to put up with rampant sexism, to the current incarnation as your first line of defense in case of an incident, they are valued airline employees. Learn all about this cool job in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The 1993 Waco Siege
episodes.description: One of the darkest days in the history of American law enforcement came on April 19, 1993, when the FBI’s 51-day siege of the Branch Davidian religious sect’s compound in Waco, Texas ended with a fire and 75 men, women, and children dead inside. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: All about BPAs
episodes.description: Are BPAs safe? Of course not. Does the FDA care? Of course not. Learn all about what and why today. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Eels Alive!
episodes.description: Eels are pretty much objectively unsettling. They’re not quite fish (although they are) and if they’re snakes, they’re messed up snakes (they aren’t). But they’re fascinating too! There are even little cute eels. It’s time you got acquainted with eels! See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Did Mallory Make it to the Top of Everest First?
episodes.description: George Mallory was a member of the first three European expeditions to Everest, world’s tallest mountain. He wanted to summit it so badly, he gave his life trying. Since that fateful day in 1924, climbers have wondered – was Mallory the first to summit? Listen as Josh and Chuck explore that question and lots more in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Hindenburg Disaster
episodes.description: Hard to believe we haven't covered this one yet, but here we are. Why did the Hindenburg crash and burn? We still don't really know. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Did Tippi Hedron start the Vietnamese manicure industry?
episodes.description: Strange but true, actor Tippi Hedron kickstsarted the Vietnamese manicure industry in the United States in the 1970s. This is that story.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Humanists, the Happy Heathens
episodes.description: If you don’t believe in any kind of god or afterlife - or even that there’s a meaning to life – does that mean you’re doomed to a life of gloom and doom? Heck no!, say humanists. Their philosophical movement says you can make your own meaningful life. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Can movies be cursed?
episodes.description: First of all, movies can't be cursed because curses aren't real. However, that can't stop Josh and Chuck from taking a look at some movies throughout history that have had a disturbing number of bad things surrounding their production and release. Dive into the world of cursed movies in this very fun classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Let's Go to Camp... David!
episodes.description: Camp David is awesome. But not all presidents have liked it. We'll dig into this historic property in today's episiode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Why do kangaroos hop?
episodes.description: Kangaroos are the only marsupial to hop, which is pretty weird. We'll investigate why.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Boeing's Nosedive: The 737-MAX
episodes.description: Boeing used to be one of the most respected engineering firms in the world. Then it changed its focus from making great airplanes to increasing its stock value. The result was the 737-MAX, a plane that took the lives of 346 people in two avoidable crashes. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Thrill to the Stunning Bicameral Mind Hypothesis
episodes.description: Psychologist Julian Jaynes came up with a stunning hypothesis in 1976, that human consciousness only developed in the last 3000 years. And he seemed to have proof in ancient texts. Scholars have been picking it apart ever since and in this classic episode we join the club. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: How to Drink a Tree's Blood
episodes.description: Of course we're talking all about maple syrup today - the tapping, the processing, the eating. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Wisdom Teeth
episodes.description: By all rights there should be three sets of molars in your mouth. But it turns out that our skulls aren’t really set up to accommodate that many anymore. Exactly why depends on who you ask. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Save the Whales!
episodes.description: In the 1970s, conservation groups around the world rose up to protect dwindling whale populations, some on the verge of extinction. They all worked under the same banner: Save the Whales! It turned out to be one of the most successful campaigns ever. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: How Fever Dreams Work
episodes.description: Fever dreams can be unsettling experiences. These ramped up nightmares are vivid, detailed and only happen when the human body experiences a fever. What is it about the combination of fevers and dreams that make these night terrors so hellish? Learn all that and more in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: UNESCO World Heritage: Preserving the Best of Humanity
episodes.description: Humanity’s created a lot of neat things over the eons and starting in the 1940s, the UN created an agency focused on preserving those things for the whole world and future people. But that mission is in danger of becoming only about branding and money. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Brown-Headed Cowbird
episodes.description: There’s a kind of bird that lots of people think is a real jerk. And it kind of is. But in the brown-headed cowbird’s defense, it’s just evolved that way. Find out why it has such a bad reputation among bird lovers in this Short Stuff. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Some Silly Inventions That Became Wildly Popular
episodes.description: Once in a while someone comes up with a solution for a problem we didn’t know we had, and maybe even a problem that didn’t even exist. Even more rarely, the stars align just right so that some crackpot invention captures everyone’s imagination. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Sammy Davis Jr: National Treasure
episodes.description: In this classic episode Josh and Chuck sit down and detail the complicated life of the late, great Sammy Davis Jr. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Sewol Ferry Disaster
episodes.description: In 2014 a ferry carrying hundreds of South Korean high school students on a field trip sunk, killing almost everyone on board. Hauntingly, their deaths were fully avoidable: everyone from the dock inspector to the Coast Guard to the president failed them. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Cherry Blossoms
episodes.description: The Japanese Cherry Blossom is a sight to behold. But how did they get to Washington D.C.? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Are Generations Even a Thing?
episodes.description: We all love to tour our generation's superiority, but who decides where the split occurs and what to name it? And is this even a thing or just an arbitrary division? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: What is a Numbers Station?
episodes.description: If you think secretly coded messages sent via short wave radio is Cold War relic, think again. In this classic episode, Chuck and Josh are here to dispel that myth, along with many others relating to numbers stations, including why they might still be operational. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: How Worker Co-ops Work
episodes.description: The worker co-op has a rich tradition and can work a variety of ways. Join us as we dig into the nuts and bolts. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: History of Spring Break
episodes.description: If you think Spring Break started with northern college kids heading to Florida to party, you'd be correct. But there's slightly more to it than that.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Roar: The Most Dangerous Movie Ever Made?
episodes.description: Jump in today to hear all about the disaster that was the movie ROAR. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: The Skinny on Lyme Disease
episodes.description: If you live in the Northeastern U.S. then you may know someone who has had Lyme disease. But it's spreading all over the country and parts of the world. Learn all about this tick-borne disease in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Colorado River Compact
episodes.description: Deciding how to share water is pretty important stuff when there isn't much of it around. Today we dive into the Colorado River Compact. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Simple Spelling Movement
episodes.description: Pretty much everyone agrees that English is a chaotic language. There are nutso rules of grammar and spelling other languages don’t have. More than once, movements have emerged to simplify English and each time they were beaten back with a vengeance.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Middle Class: Canary in the Gold Mine
episodes.description: Lots of nations gauge the health of their country by how the middle class is doing. There’s just one issue with that – no one can say exactly what defines the middle class. But even when you take a guess, it seems like the health isn’t so good these days. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: The Disappearance of Lars Mittank
episodes.description: In 2014, a young German man walked into an airport in Bulgaria with a flight booked, then suddenly ran out leaving all his posessions behind, never to be heard from again. This classic episode tells the story of Lars Mittank. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Malcom X
episodes.description: Malcolm X was one of the most revered, feared leaders of the civil rights movement. In contrast to Martin Luther King, Jr., X advocated black self-reliance and separateness in American society and that equal rights should obtained by any means necessary. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Kentucky Meat Shower
episodes.description: In 1876 it rained meat out of the clear blue sky on a homestead in Bath County, Kentucky. While the mystery of what happened will never be solved, the best explanation makes the story even weirder than it seems. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The History of Fire
episodes.description: The first fires came from lightning strikes. After that, no one is super sure when we started controlling it and then later, starting our own. But it's sure fun to speculate! See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Everything You Ever Wanted to Know About Gin
episodes.description: If there's one thing we've learned about Chuck over the years it's that he loves his gin. And he loves it even more now that understands it. Pour yourself a martini and cozy up to the classic gin-cast.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Caterpillars: Nature's Magicians
episodes.description: Caterpillars are simply the best. Don't think so? Well listen in and you'll soon agree. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Butterflies: Caterpillars with Wings!
episodes.description: If you thought caterpillars were awesome, just wait until you see them with colorful, iridescent wings! See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: How Snails Work
episodes.description: They seem gross and bothersome at first, but once you get down to ground level and get to know snails, we’ll bet you’ll grow quite fond of them. They are living in a whole world we’re largely unaware of. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Fascinating History of Dandelions
episodes.description: Dandelions are way more interesting than you think. Trust us and click play. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: What's Permaculture All About?
episodes.description: Permaculture is a growing trend in the world of farming and home landscaping. It's basically a design principle that emphasizes sustainability and the would-be, natural ecosystem of an area. Simple concepts like planting downhill from a pond and using gravity to feed plants to planting native plants and vegetation that work well together are hallmarks of permaculture. Learn all about this eco-friendly trend today. Se

episodes.title: How Sneezing Works
episodes.description: Unless you have an arcane disorder from a lesion on a very specific spot on our medulla, the chances are you sneeze. Turns out most animals do it, even lizards! Learn the whys and hows of this most interesting involuntary reflex. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Wetlands! Wetlands! Wetlands!
episodes.description: It’s time to get jazzed up for some Earth science of the waterlogged variety. Join Chuck and Josh as they tour some of the most interesting ecosystems on the planet and learn why we need to stop destroying them post haste. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Composting: Nature's Most Interesting Process
episodes.description: You may think composting is just a bunch of old banana peels rotting away into dirt but, friend, you're not looking closely enough. Inside that compost pile is a microcosmic universe doing some magical stuff. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Squirrels, Ahoy!
episodes.description: Squirrels are rodents, sure, but they’re rodents with personalities the size of Las Vegas and Detroit put together. Get to know your bushy-tailed (and sometimes not so bushy) neighbors who live interesting hidden lives right out in the open. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Honey: Nature's Wonder Sugar
episodes.description: Honey is an amazing thing. Just ask any bee. They make a ton of it. So much that humans get what bees can't use and that's a lot of honey. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Contortionism: Bend It Like Gumby
episodes.description: If you could put your leg behind your head, would you? Of course you would! You might even make a career out of it, amazing people around the world with your flexibility. That’d make you a contortionist! But first you’d better get started with stretching. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Jeddah Tower
episodes.description: The Jeddah Tower is set to be the tallest building in the world. If it ever gets finished.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Ruth Lyons: TV Pioneer
episodes.description: Ruth Lyons basically invented the daytime talk show, yet she doesn't get the credit. Why is that? Probably because she was a woman in a man's industry. Today we tell her story. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Mangroves: Nature's Best Tree?
episodes.description: Mangroves are incredible survivors and adapters. They're also amazing at lessening the impact of tropical storms and climate change. And heck, they're cool looking. So jump into the brackish waters and have a listen to this classic episode all about these beauts. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: How the Kowloon Walled City Worked
episodes.description: From the 1970s to the early 1990s a patch of land in Hong Kong the size of just a few football fields was the most densely-populated area in the world – and by a longshot. Even more remarkable, it was an outlaw land that somehow formed a tight community. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: In-Flight Entertainment
episodes.description: Movies on planes have changed a lot in the last couple of decades. Today, we'll go over how this stuff works.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Fyre Festival Fiasco
episodes.description: What happens when a career grifter tries to throw a "luxury" music festival in only six months? Not much it turns out.This was the Fyre Festival. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: How Spiritualism Works
episodes.description: Something spooky was born on the American frontier in the mid-19th century: the idea that people’s personalities survive death and that some gifted individuals can communicate with them. It developed into a religion that some still practice today. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Let's All Go to the World's Fair
episodes.description: Before the internet could show you anything in the universe - including stuff it made up - people had few opportunities to have their minds blown. But every few years, somewhere in the world nations would gather and show off the cool stuff they invented. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Johnny Ringo
episodes.description: You might be familiar with the outlaw Johnny Ringo from the movie Tombstone. He was indeed a real-life black hat gunslinger, and a tragic figure at that. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Gold Standard: When Money Meant Something
episodes.description: There was a time less than 100 years ago when you could exchange your paper currency at the bank for actual gold. Gave folks a sense of stability, it did. Depending on your view, we either ruined or built our economies when money became just paper. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: How Dopamine Works
episodes.description: Dopamine is perhaps the most talked-about, most misunderstood biochemical in our bodies. It’s linked to not only addiction and depravity, but also focus, motivation, and living a productive life. How can one molecule be so many things to so many people? Find out all about it in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Battle of the Sexes
episodes.description: Back in 1973 a male chauvinist played tennis against champion Billie Jean King. This is that story. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: MacGuffins
episodes.description: What’s a MacGuffin? We don’t know. No one knows. But it has to do with movies and that’s fun to talk about. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Murder of Jane Stanford
episodes.description: Stanford University was co-founded by Jane Stanford. Not long after she was murdered and it was covered up. We'll probably never know what really happened. Listen in today. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: How Free Range Parenting Works
episodes.description: Free range parenting is all about giving your child the freedom to play and explore life on their own. Are there benefits? Sure. Do some people hate the concept? Yes! Listen to this classic episode and learn right here.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: How the Flexner Report Changed Medicine
episodes.description: The Flexner Report shook up medicine in the United States when it was released in 1910 and it's never been the same since. For better or worse. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Safety Coffins
episodes.description: Back in the 1800s, people had an outsized fear of being buried alive. Enter... THE SAFETY COFFIN! See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: How Crowds Work
episodes.description: If you’ve ever been out of your house you’ve probably been in a crowd before. They can be as mundane as an elevator full of people or as consequential as a mass of protesters. But did you know there’s psychology to crowds? And they follow fluid dynamics? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: How Charles Darwin Worked
episodes.description: Charles Darwin wasn't the first or only scientist to grasp the theory of evolution through natural selection, but he became its father and icon. In this classic episode, learn about the man who reluctantly but bravely became the source of the divide between religion and science. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: How Lasers Work
episodes.description: It turns out that lasers are even cooler than they look. And as far as acronyms go, they’re pretty solid in that respect too. There’s way too much cool stuff about lasers to tease here so listen to this old school SYSK episode and let lasers blow away. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Aztec Death Whistle
episodes.description: In the late 90s, a strange musical instrument was excavated under the streets of CDMX. Listen in to learn all about the Aztec Death Whistle.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: How Cognitive Biases Work
episodes.description: Humans have all sorts of weird quirks that cause us to do silly things and make bad decisions. It’s not our fault though. Our brains are wired that way. Learn about the psychology of cognitive biases in this episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Why Do Great Flood Myths Seem To Be Universal?
episodes.description: If look into the mythology of just about any culture in the world, you will find a myth about a great flood that destroyed humanity and submerged the Earth in the distant past. Does this mean that a great flood actually happened? Listen to this classic episode to explore the possibilities with Josh and Chuck. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Cajun Navy: Heroes or Liability?
episodes.description: The Cajun Navy was formed after Hurricane Katrina and really got its legs after the Louisiana flood of 2016.  They save a lot of lives, but some fear the pitfalls of "vigilante heroism." Learn all about this group of do-gooders today.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Color Psychology
episodes.description: Have you ever cried way longer than usual when you were in a yellow room? You’ve been smacked by color psychology my friend and it’s got your number. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Helen Keller and Anne Sullivan: Miracle is Right
episodes.description: Helen Keller and Anne Sullivan were one of the most amazing non-magical duos in history. Imagine living trapped in your own mind – unable to see or hear – and then imagine learning to read, traveling the world, and becoming an ambassador of peace.    See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Operation Mincemeat: How A Corpse Fooled the Nazis
episodes.description: In World War II, a secret department of British 'corkscrew thinkers' hatched a plan to use the cadaver of an unclaimed homeless man to turn the tide of the war in the Allies' favor. It worked. Listen to this classic episode as Josh and Chuck take you through the real life tale. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Magnificent Golden Gate Bridge
episodes.description: If you think the Golden Gate Bridge is named because of its color then you are wrong. That name proceeds the bridge by a long time. But that’s just one interesting fact about this amazing structure. Tune in today. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Magic 8 Ball
episodes.description: The Magic 8 Ball, the mystical fortune telling pool ball started out as a piece of customer swag for the Brunswick Billiard Company.  Since then, it has changed the course of history and shaped nations. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Charge of the Light Brigade
episodes.description: The Charge of the Light Brigade is a famous poem about a lesser famous military action during the Crimean War. Tune in today for a rare SYSK walk through wartime history. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: The Truth Behind Cage-Free and Free-Range
episodes.description: You’d think terms like cage-free and free-range means the chickens we eat are frolicking happily in the fresh air under the shining sun, but you’d be so, so wrong. Cage-free is a huge improvement but free-range is lacking and both have a long way to go. Find out all about both in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Ballad of Biggie and Tupac
episodes.description: Biggie Smalls and Tupac Shakur had a famous beef with one another in the mid-90s. It was so intense, it sparked an even wider rivalry between the East and West Coasts. In just a few years, both men had been murdered and the music world was changed forever. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: The S7VEN Deadly Sins
episodes.description: The Seven Deadly Sins are tied to religion, but not really in the Bible. So where did this naughty list come from? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Keeping Time
episodes.description: Today, Chuck and Josh walk you through the history of keeping time, from sticks in the sun to atomic clocks. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: BPD: The Worst Disorder or Not a Disorder at All?
episodes.description: Borderline Personality Disorder has been described as emotional “third degree burns over ninety percent of your body.” It’s as close to a curse as a personality disorder can be: deep fear of being abandoned creates behaviors that end up driving people off. Learn all about it in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Data Centers: Can't Live With Em, Can't Live Without Em
episodes.description: Data centers are the backbone of our digital world. All the sites you visit and social media you post happen there. A boom in huge data centers to support AI is underway, and they’re taking a big toll on the environment and life for the people around them. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Did a vampire legend help win the Cold War?
episodes.description: During the Cold War, the CIA used the legend of a vampire named Aswang to scare locals into not helping the communists.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Doin’ Science in the National Radio Quiet Zone
episodes.description: West Virginia is home to sensitive radio telescopes that could easily pick up your cell phone’s signal on Mars. And the cell reception on Mars is about as good as it is in the NRQZ, since cell towers are banned in the interest of furthering astronomy. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: How Forgiveness Works
episodes.description: For most of history, forgiveness fell under the domain of religion. But in the 1980s science started investigating it and found that forgiving someone is really, really good for you. Learn how anybody can be the better person in this classic, and really great, episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The SAD Episode
episodes.description: Seasonal affective disorder, or SAD, is much more than the winter blues. It's a serious subset of depression. Learn all about it and what to do if you suffer from it today.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Neighborhood Watch
episodes.description: Since 1972 neighborhoods have been officially banding together to prevent crime together. Does it work? It seems to. Does it go too far? It often does, yes. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: The Warrens: Paranormal Power Couple
episodes.description: Today we dive into the interesting story of paranormal power couple the Warrens, inspiration behind The Conjuring movie franchise.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: MC Escher and His Trippy Art
episodes.description: We love us some MC Escher. Turns out his story is pretty fascinating too. Tune in to this classic episode and find out all about it with Josh and Chuck. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: TV Moments That Changed The World
episodes.description: Whatever you think of TV, you have to admit it has shaped the world (maybe more than the internet, according to Josh). There have been moments here or there in TV history where the world took a new course and we go over some of them in this episode.   See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: All About Porcelain
episodes.description: What exactly is this durable ceramic anyway? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: What We Lost When We Lost Home Ec
episodes.description: Home economics seems antiquated – a class that teaches high school kids how to bake a cake and sew doesn’t sound super useful. But would you believe that everything from the obesity epidemic to student debt can be chalked up to home ec disappearing? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: How Miniature Golf Works
episodes.description: Playing miniature golf is a very fun thing to do and, you’re about to find, learning about its origin and history is very fun as well. Join Josh and Chuck in this classic episode as they tee off on the mini golf story! See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Dolls and Dolls, Guys!
episodes.description: In this special Christmas Day episode, we get cuddly with one of the all-time great holiday gifts, dolls! Where did they come from? Why are the so cute? Why are they sometimes creepy? Why do they tell us to do things we don’t want to with their minds? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Why is holly a holiday thing?
episodes.description: Holly is waxy and super sharp, not exactly the kind of thing you'd want all over your house. Yet it happens every holiday season. Today we dig in to discover why. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK's 2025 Holiday Extravaganza Christmas Special
episodes.description: Deck your tidings and get your halls nice and gladded because it’s time for maybe the best episode of the year, where SYSK loosens our ties, puts on our smoking jackets and Santa hats and create holiday nostalgia in real time. Happy holidays, everybody! See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: PT Barnum: More Complicated Than You've Heard
episodes.description: When your life is as outsized as the World’s Greatest Showman PT Barnum it’s pretty easy to - you know - gloss over the grimmer aspects when you turn it into an uplifting musical movie. But the way to understand a person is to look at them, warts and all. Josh and Chuck take a full accounting in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Doggerland: Lost at Sea
episodes.description: The story of Doggerland is pretty fascinating. The idea is that mainland Europe and the UK were connected not only by a land bridge, but a place where plants, animals and even humans, thrived.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Battle of Itter Castle
episodes.description: At the end of WWII in Europe, one of the strangest battles of the war took place between German troops fighting alongside Americans and French to beat back an assault by the Nazi SS. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Battle Royale: Optimists vs Pessimists
episodes.description: Everybody’s always bagging on pessimists and telling everybody they should be more optimistic. Well, nuts to that! There are plenty of benefits from being a pessimist. Although being an optimist still wins in basically every category ☹ See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: Star Wars Holiday Spectacular
episodes.description: Long ago, in a galaxy not so far away, George Lucas allowed the Star Wars Holiday Special to be made. What happened on the night of November 17, 1978 can never be fully explained, but we make our best effort in our annual special edition of SYSK. May the force be with us all. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK's 12 Days of Christmas… Toys: What Makes a Must-Have Christmas Toy?
episodes.description: Ever since Cabbage Patch Kids came along in 1983, there’s been an annual holiday frenzy around one particular toy – the must-have Christmas toy of the year. But what makes a toy a must-have toy? Josh and Chuck investigate (and kick off the holidays). See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK's 12 Days of Christmas… Toys: How Play-Doh Works
episodes.description: Do you love Play-Doh? Chuck and Josh certainly love to talk about it, from its interesting history as a wall cleaner, to its more scientific chemical properties. It's everything you ever wanted to know about the pliable children's toy. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK's 12 Days of Christmas… Toys: How Yo-Yos Work
episodes.description: You may have played with a yo-yo before -- perhaps you've even walked the dog -- but do you know about the physics behind what makes a yo-yo sleep and wake up? Learn all about inertia, angular momentum and the history of the yo-yo in this episode of SYSK. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK's 12 Days of Christmas… Toys: A Partial History of Action Figures
episodes.description: Action figures have a long and glorious history. From GI Joes to Star Wars figures, these offshoots of dolls came along at just the right time to capture the hearts and minds of children everywhere. Learn all about the partial history of action figures right here. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK's 12 Days of Christmas… Toys: Cabbage Patch Kids: Must-Have Toy of the Century
episodes.description: Surprisingly, Cabbage Patch Kids have turned up on SYSK almost as much as the Nazis or Seinfeld. It’s finally time to dive all the way into CPKs, from their controversial origins to the Christmas craze of ‘83 to their alter egos, Garbage Pail Kids. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK's 12 Days of Christmas… Toys: Hula-Hoops: The Toy That's A Shape
episodes.description: We've covered our fair share of pop-culture icons and here is another - Hula-Hoops. They've been around since ancient time in some form or another, but made their name in during the Hoop Boom of the 1950s. Learn all about this popular fad and more. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK's 12 Days of Christmas… Toys: How Monopoly Works
episodes.description: Since more than 1 billion people have played it, you're probably familiar with the board game Monopoly, but we bet you don't know its secret origins as a left-wing socialist teaching tool. Learn about the history, rules and cultural impact of Monopoly. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK's 12 Days of Christmas… Toys: Beanie Babies: Reigning Toy Craze Champion
episodes.description: The world has seen a lot of weird investment bubbles in its time, but few of them rival the fever that gripped the world in the 90s after Beanie Babies took off. Let’s visit this strange chapter in toy history together. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK's 12 Days of Christmas… Toys: Etch A Sketch!
episodes.description: The Etch A Sketch is yet another classic toy that Josh and Chuck love and respect. Learn all about this Hall of Fame entry today. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK's 12 Days of Christmas… Toys: How the Nintendo Entertainment System Changed Gaming Forever
episodes.description: For the holidays in 1986 (and ’87) (and ’88) the most stupendous, most wanted, most amazing thing any kid could possibly get – outside of a pony, *maybe* – was the NES. That year, video games came back from the dead and changed forever. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK's 12 Days of Christmas… Toys: How Hot Wheels Work
episodes.description: If you're an American who had a childhood, you probably have some nostalgia for Hot Wheels. Get your engines revved for this trip down memory lane as we discuss these fun and iconic toys. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: SYSK's 12 Days of Christmas… Toys: How Easy Bake Ovens Work
episodes.description: Easy Bake Ovens are as iconic as a toy can get, as American as apple pie or baseball. Learn all about these light bulb cooking, working ovens that endanger children to this day, in this classic episode. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: A Quick History of the BBC
episodes.description: The BBC has been around as long as there has been radio. Today we salute the venerable institution that's as British as tea and crumpets.  See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Short Stuff: Atacama Skeleton
episodes.description: In 2003, a tiny – really, really tiny – humanoid skeleton surfaced that had been taken from Chile. The only possible explanation is that it had to be an alien mummy. Right? See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Operation Paul Bunyan
episodes.description: If we told you that World War III was in danger of happening over the trimming of a tree would you believe us? This was Operation Paul Bunyan. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

episodes.title: Selects: What Is A Mold-A-Rama?
